csv_project_name: DB for MCB Barracks Initiative Package 2
csv_scope_of_work: Naval Facilities Engineering System Command (NAVFAC) Mid-Atlantic is soliciting comments from the public addressing the potential use of Project Labor Agreements (PLA) for construction project to replace Bachelor Enlisted Quarters (BEQ) located at the Marine Corps Base (MCB) in Camp Lejeune, North Carolina. This Design-Build project includes the demolition of five Bachelor Enlisted Quarters Buildings and will provide by replacement billeting capacity of 565 two-person rooms to support 1,130 personnel at Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune.
